title: Smoky Vegan Paella
description: A flavorful and hearty Spanish-inspired paella dish, made with smoky vegetables and served as a satisfying dinner option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked paprika and thyme; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mixed vegetable blend, bell peppers, and zucchini; cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Spanish rice, smoked sweet potato, salt, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it sit for 5 minutes, covered.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
